situations.title: ROSC 직후 안정화 사정
situations.tagline: We just got ROSC — let's reassess his airway, breathing, and circulation right away.
situations.brief: ROSC 직후 기도와 호흡, 순환을 재확인하며 환자를 안정화하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm the airway is secure and he's oxygenating.
Check his pulse, blood pressure, and rhythm now.
We stabilize ABCs before anything else post-ROSC.
goals: ROSC 직후 기도와 호흡, 순환을 재확인한다

situations.title: 12유도 심전도·원인 검사
situations.tagline: Let's get a twelve-lead now — we need to know if he needs the cath lab.
situations.brief: 12유도 심전도와 원인 검사로 재관류 필요성을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: Get a twelve-lead ECG to look for STEMI.
Send troponin and a full metabolic panel.
If it's a STEMI, we activate the cath lab.

situations.title: TTM 목표체온 준비
situations.tagline: Let's set up for targeted temperature management — grab the cooling device and confirm the target.
situations.brief: 냉각장비를 준비하고 TTM 목표체온을 설정하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm our TTM target temperature with the team.
Set up the cooling device and place the temperature probe.
We'll document the start time and initial temperature.

situations.title: 체온·전해질 모니터
situations.tagline: While we're cooling, let's keep a close watch on his temperature and electrolytes.
situations.brief: 냉각 중 체온과 전해질 지표를 지속 모니터하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's track his core temperature continuously.
Cooling shifts potassium, so recheck electrolytes often.
Watch for trends, not just single values.

situations.title: 진정·통증 관리 기초
situations.tagline: He's being cooled, so let's make sure he's sedated and comfortable throughout.
situations.brief: 냉각 중 편안함을 위해 진정과 통증 관리의 기초를 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Cooling can be uncomfortable, so we sedate adequately.
Let's manage his pain and monitor for shivering.
Comfort during TTM is part of good care.

situations.title: 지속 심전도·혈역학 감시
situations.tagline: He just arrested, so let's keep continuous monitoring and be ready if he re-arrests.
situations.brief: 재정지에 대비해 지속 심전도와 혈역학을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Keep him on continuous ECG and arterial monitoring.
Watch for any rhythm change or dropping pressure.
Have the crash cart close in case he re-arrests.

situations.title: TTM 냉각 유도·유지 관리
situations.tagline: Let's drive him down to target and then hold him steady there — how are we tracking?
situations.brief: TTM 목표 도달과 안정적 유지를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We're inducing cooling toward our target now.
Once there, we hold the temperature tightly stable.
Avoid overshooting below the target range.

situations.title: shivering 관리
situations.tagline: He's starting to shiver — that's fighting our cooling, let's follow the shivering protocol.
situations.brief: 진전 억제 프로토콜로 냉각 중 shivering을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Shivering raises metabolism and fights the cooling.
Let's follow the shivering protocol step by step.
Surface counterwarming and sedation can help control it.

situations.title: 재관류 PCI 이송·조율
situations.tagline: Cath lab is ready for him — let's coordinate the transfer safely with all his drips.
situations.brief: cath lab 연계로 재관류 PCI 이송을 안전하게 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm the cath lab is ready before we move.
Secure all lines and the airway for transport.
Bring the monitor, meds, and a bag valve for the trip.

situations.title: ROSC 후 혈역학 목표 유지
situations.tagline: His MAP is drifting low — let's keep his perfusion pressure at goal post-ROSC.
situations.brief: MAP와 관류 목표를 유지하며 ROSC 후 혈역학을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's keep his MAP at or above our target.
Titrate vasopressors and fluids to maintain perfusion.
Good perfusion protects his brain after arrest.

situations.title: ROSC 후 환기·산소 목표
situations.tagline: Let's target normal oxygen and CO2 — we don't want to over-oxygenate or over-ventilate him.
situations.brief: 정상탄산과 정상산소를 목표로 ROSC 후 환기와 산소를 조절하세요.
keyPhrases: Aim for normoxia, not maximal oxygen, after ROSC.
Keep his CO2 in the normal range.
Both hyperoxia and hypocapnia can harm the brain.

situations.title: 재가온 단계 관리
situations.tagline: We're starting to rewarm him now — let's go slow and watch for complications.
situations.brief: rewarming 속도와 부작용을 관리하며 재가온 단계를 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: Rewarm slowly to avoid rebound complications.
Watch for vasodilation, hypotension, and hyperkalemia shifts.
Controlled rewarming protects his recovery.

situations.title: 발작·경련 감시
situations.tagline: Let's watch closely for seizures — post-arrest patients can have subtle activity.
situations.brief: post-arrest seizure를 인지하기 위해 발작과 경련을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Post-arrest seizures can be subtle, like eye twitching.
Let's consider EEG monitoring for nonconvulsive activity.
Report any abnormal movements right away.

situations.title: K 전해질 변동 관리
situations.tagline: Cooling drove his potassium down and rewarming may push it back up — let's manage it carefully.
situations.brief: 냉각과 재가온에 따른 K 이동을 이해하고 전해질 변동을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Cooling shifts potassium into cells, lowering serum levels.
Rewarming can cause rebound hyperkalemia.
Let's recheck potassium frequently and correct cautiously.

situations.title: 신경학적 예후 검사 준비
situations.tagline: Let's line up his neuro-prognostication studies over the next few days.
situations.brief: 다중검사 일정을 세워 신경학적 예후 검사를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Prognostication relies on multiple tests over time, not one.
Let's schedule the neuro exam, imaging, and EEG.
We avoid predicting outcome too early.

situations.title: 재정지 즉각 소생
situations.tagline: 모니터에 심실세동이 뜨고 환자의 맥박이 사라진다.
situations.brief: 재정지 시 CPR 재개와 팀 대응으로 즉각 소생하세요.
keyPhrases: He's in VFib and lost his pulse — start compressions now.
Charge the defibrillator and clear for a shock.
Call the code and assign roles quickly.

situations.title: 재가온 중 혈압 붕괴 위기
situations.tagline: 재가온을 시작하자 혈관이 확장되며 환자의 혈압이 급격히 무너진다.
situations.brief: 재가온 중 혈압 붕괴 위기에 승압과 수액으로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Rewarming vasodilation is crashing his pressure.
Let's bolus fluids and start a vasopressor now.
Slow the rewarming rate while we stabilize him.

situations.title: 냉각 중 부정맥 위기
situations.tagline: 저체온 상태에서 환자의 심박이 급격히 느려지고 심실빈맥으로 전환된다.
situations.brief: 냉각 중 서맥과 VT 위기를 처치하고 목표체온을 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: Deep hypothermia is causing bradycardia and now VT.
Let's treat the arrhythmia and consider warming him slightly.
Cold hearts resist drugs, so temperature matters here.

situations.title: 신경학적 예후 불량 가족 상담
situations.tagline: 딸이 아버지가 깨어날 가능성이 정말 없는 거냐고 떨리는 목소리로 묻는다.
situations.brief: 나쁜 소식과 치료 목표를 다루며 신경학적 예후 불량을 가족과 상담하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm so sorry — his brain injury appears very severe.
The tests point to a poor chance of meaningful recovery.
Let's talk about what he would have wanted for his care.

situations.title: 뇌사 진행 평가 연계
situations.tagline: His exam is consistent with progression toward brain death — let's coordinate the next steps carefully.
situations.brief: 뇌사 진행 평가를 연계하고 장기기증 논의 시작을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: His neurologic exam suggests progression to brain death.
Let's coordinate formal brain death testing per protocol.
We'll involve the organ procurement organization appropriately.

situations.title: 연명과 중단 윤리 갈등
situations.tagline: 형제들이 치료를 계속하자와 그만하자로 나뉘어 병상 앞에서 목소리를 높인다.
situations.brief: 다학제와 가족 논의로 연명과 중단을 둘러싼 윤리 갈등을 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: I can see this is an incredibly hard decision for the family.
Let's focus on what he would have wanted for himself.
We can bring in the ethics team and palliative care to help.
goals: 가족 간 윤리 갈등을 존중하며 중재한다
